_comment: Cross-language pin for the capture-produced ingestion warning envelope. Asserted against real capture output by rust/capture/tests/ingestion_warnings_integration.rs, and replayed as consumer input by nodejs/tests/ingestion/pipelines/clientwarnings/consumer-e2e.test.ts. Editing this by hand without changing both sides is the bug it exists to catch. Only the inner event's stable fields are pinned: uuid, timestamps, and the token vary per run, and distinctId/eventUuid are absent by construction because the fixture's batch drops two events under one type (see emit_validation_drop_warnings).
